title: Relay main window
brief: Main window of Relay, a keyboard-first, local-first desktop HTTP client (Postman-like): workspace and collection tree, environment selector, request editor with drafts and explicit save, response view. Developer audience, dense, dark by default.

artboards.title: Classic stacked
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar to Postman users and fits long forms; the response only gets the lower half of the height on a wide screen

artboards.title: Side by side with rail
artboards.tradeoff: Uses wide screens, request and response visible together; long URLs and wide header tables get cramped

artboards.title: Document and palette
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest for keyboard use, request reads like an .http file; least discoverable, and form-like parts (form-data, auth) fit text worse
